description: Runtime-level open items found by live verification. Hand-maintained; each entry cites its evidence. Rendered into audit/unresolved-items.md by tools/build.py.

environment_restricted.evidence: https://skills.sh CONNECT 403 from this environment's proxy (curl + omega.py doctor)
environment_restricted.requirement: Network policy allowing https://skills.sh; re-run `npx skills@1.7.4 find react` and `omega.py doctor`

environment_restricted.evidence: /usr/bin/yq is the jq-wrapper yq 0.0.0; script uses mikefarah yq v4 syntax (strenv)
--strict promotes two warnings (root CLAUDE.md not loaded; missing icon) to errors; non-strict validation passes
environment_restricted.requirement: Upstream adds an icon / validator version that does not flag these; not an integration issue

upstream_limitations.item: claude-mem committed build artifacts lag src/ (LAUNCHER_PROTOCOL 2 in src, 1 in plugin/scripts)
upstream_limitations.evidence: 4 launcher tests fail at pinned commit dcb28a7 (= upstream main); pass 96/96 after upstream `npm run build`; published npm 15.0.1 ships ensure-launcher.cjs byte-identical to the integrated copy (protocol 1, self-consistent)
upstream_limitations.impact: Repo tests only; shipped artifacts are internally consistent. Live install placed a protocol-1 launcher and hooks worked.

upstream_limitations.item: claude-mem test tests/memory/native-memory-bridge.test.ts writes to the real $HOME/.claude-mem
upstream_limitations.evidence: Run with an isolated HOME creates $HOME/.claude-mem/settings.json and a log line
upstream_limitations.impact: Test isolation only. Baseline runner isolates HOME.

upstream_limitations.item: `npx skills find` reports network failures as 'No skills found'
upstream_limitations.impact: Misleading output; omega.py doctor now checks skills.sh reachability

upstream_limitations.item: ECC hooks need npm dependencies that plugin installs do not provide
upstream_limitations.evidence: SessionStart: Cannot find module 'js-yaml' (scripts/lib/project-detect.js); upstream TROUBLESHOOTING.md MODULE_NOT_FOUND
upstream_limitations.impact: Mitigated: scripts/install-plugin-deps.sh + doctor check; verified hooks exit 0 afterwards

upstream_limitations.item: claude-mem plain `/plugin install` leaves the plugin's npm deps (tree-sitter grammars, zod) uninstalled
upstream_limitations.impact: Capture/search still worked; tree-sitter features need `npx claude-mem install`

upstream_limitations.item: claude-mem first session after install: hooks cannot find the `claude-mem` launcher
upstream_limitations.evidence: Executable not found in $PATH: "claude-mem" in session 1; works from session 2 with ~/.local/bin on PATH

fixed_in_release_gate.item: Nondeterministic build output (registry/audit ordering depended on PYTHONHASHSEED)

fixed_in_release_gate.item: ECC SessionStart hook crash (Cannot find module 'js-yaml') with no OMEGA guidance

fixed_in_release_gate.item: find-skills network failures indistinguishable from empty results

fixed_in_release_gate.item: tools/subreaper.py waited for every descendant, so a daemon left by a test suite hung the runner until timeout (claude-mem exit 124 after 0 failures)
fixed_in_release_gate.fix: return as soon as the command exits, after reaping pending zombies

fixed_in_release_gate.item: Baseline runner let claude-mem's tests write to the real $HOME/.claude-mem
fixed_in_release_gate.fix: tools/run-baselines.sh runs claude-mem tests with a throwaway HOME that links only ~/.cache, ~/.local and ~/.bun (a fully empty HOME made the Chroma connection-failure test time out: 0/1 vs 1/1 with the real HOME); stray /root/.claude-mem (default settings + fixture log lines) removed
fixed_in_release_gate.regression_test: manual: chroma-vector-sync 15/15 and native-memory-bridge writes contained in the throwaway HOME; /root/.claude-mem absent after the corrected re-run

fixed_in_release_gate.item: docs/INSTALL.md: claude-mem export/import used wrong runner (bun) and paths that looked repo-relative
fixed_in_release_gate.fix: commands replaced by the ones actually run (npx tsx ./scripts/... from a source copy with deps)

fixed_in_release_gate.item: unresolved-items.md reported 'none' while capabilities were unverified
fixed_in_release_gate.fix: report now has registry and runtime levels rendered from audit/open-items.json
